headline: Fixed C169 does not retain paid gains across the two additional Native Seeds; close its further optimization and keep B default.
rationale: All 22 positions qualify, but no n35 role improves its final original U on both new Seeds. C35 worsens U by 36.83%/4.06% at Seeds1/2. B35 changes from a 19.32% improvement to a 10.46% regression; X35 changes from a 1.67% improvement to a 0.98% regression. Absolute gap improves only on B35 Seed1. All n35 methods remain OPEN. C20 certifies the same objective in all four runs, but C/B process certificate-time ratios are 1.00657 and 1.33224. The fixed recipe is a real initialization improvement with a few paid local positives, not a confirmed complete-method improvement on these selected exposed roles.
CB_interpretation: C35 has U_C/U_B=0.153146346/0.111923531 at Seed1 and 0.120416911/0.115716279 at Seed2: U worsens by 36.83% and 4.06%, despite qualified L rising by 0.000988956 and 0.000453066. B35 Seed1 improves U from 0.208920932 to 0.168556839 and absolute gap from 0.089941911 to 0.050743956, while L falls from 0.118979021 to 0.117812883. At Seed2 B35 instead worsens U from 0.174276652 to 0.192502133 and gap from 0.055950983 to 0.073128570, although L rises by 0.001047893. X35 Seed1 lowers U by 1.67% but loses 0.010357962 in L, increasing absolute gap; Seed2 worsens both U and L. Thus two of six n35 U differences favor C and four favor B at the frozen materiality scale; this is a descriptive count, not statistical inference. C20 B/C certificate process times are 369.447218/371.873503s at Seed1 and 327.315304/436.063731s at Seed2, with the same qualified original optimum 0.191280592. Its observed C proof-cost regression persists and becomes substantial at Seed2.
CM_interpretation: At Seed1, M retains exactly B's selected original initial U and final U on all three n35 roles, with the same base fleet and first actual model. Delta_restart is zero; Delta_weight is 0.0193247782, 0.0129816883 and 0.0928704721 for C35/B35/X35. C's paid final U is nevertheless 36.83% worse than M on C35, 19.32% better on B35 and 1.67% better on X35. The two Seed1 primal gains therefore go beyond the observed original-weight restarts, but do not survive as consistent Seed1/2 C/B gains. Equal extra-H call counts do not imply equal work or equal remaining Native time; M's small C35/X35 lower differences and its Work/nodes are retained.
BP_interpretation: All three new strictly matched Seed1 B/P pairs favor B in U, qualified L and absolute/relative gap, with no new certificate. C35 B/P is U 0.111923531/0.246549891 and L 0.014493297/0.004824442; B35 is U 0.208920932/0.318124373 and L 0.118979021/0.114075087; X35 is U 0.480063480/0.599347390 and L 0.361009691/0.348077713. B's U reductions relative to P are 54.60%, 34.33% and 19.90%. These are three new same-budget run-pair advantage observations on already exposed physical inputs, not three new physical instances, population wins or certificate-speed comparisons.
CP_interpretation: Separately, C also has lower U, higher qualified L and smaller gaps than the same three cold P runs: C/P U reductions are 37.88%, 47.02% and 21.24% on C35/B35/X35. C adds a better Seed1 U than B on B35 and X35, at weaker L, but loses to B on C35. B already improves all those P endpoints. C/P therefore supplies bounded candidate endpoint evidence, not a promotion of C, a new certificate or extra default-method B/P wins. No M/P Seed2 cells exist and no historical long-cap P is borrowed.
decision_explanation: Close further optimization of the fixed C169 recipe. Preserve its correctly paid complete-H initialization improvements and the B35/X35 Seed1 primal positives as local research findings, together with every adverse U/L/gap and C20 time result. Do not promote it as a candidate confirmed across these two additional Native Seeds. B/GI-TBC remains uniform default and C166/D167/C169 remain default off. This closes this recipe without adding weights, H seeds, a third Native Seed, longer caps, new neighborhoods or a successor round.
next_recommendation: Use the completed mixed/negative confirmation in the current manuscript's external scientific assessment; pursue no additional C169 optimization campaign on this evidence.
author_assessment: The new same-budget B/P evidence strengthens the bounded EJOR/TRE computational case for the integrated default method, while the fixed reweighting study narrows the initialization claim and exposes primal/proof search-trajectory sensitivity. It does not establish a new OR principle: scalarization/multistart and feasible-fleet transfer retain their existing attribution, and no broader theory or unexposed-input validity is supplied. The manuscript should present the negative confirmation as part of the method's limits, rather than advertise a new generally faster candidate. Further external validity remains unestablished, but no extra confirmation is automatically prescribed.
paper_results: The new C/B results reverse the initial interpretation. C35's final U is worse by36.83%/4.06% at Seeds1/2, despite stronger L. B35 improves U by19.32% at Seed1 but worsens it by10.46% at Seed2. X35 improves U by1.67% at Seed1 and worsens it by0.98% at Seed2, with weaker L at both. Only B35 Seed1 reduces absolute gap; X35 Seed1's smaller U accompanies a larger absolute gap. M retains B's initial and final U at all three Seed1 roles, so the B35/X35 Seed1 gains exceed these matched restarts but do not repeat across the two new C/B trajectories. All n35 observations remain OPEN. C20 certifies the same objective in every run, with B/C process times369.447/371.874s and327.315/436.064s: C's proof-cost regression persists. Against the new cold P, B and C each improve U, L and gap at all three Seed1 roles. B/P U reductions are54.60%,34.33%,19.90%; C/P reductions are37.88%,47.02%,21.24%. These three B/P endpoint advantage observations add no certificate or physical input. The candidate comparison is separate from the default-method evidence.
paper_decision: Close further optimization of this fixed recipe. Retain its initialization and local paid positives as bounded findings, with B remaining uniform default and C169 default off; this selected exposed-input study does not confirm a repeatable complete-method benefit.
paper_conclusion: Paid objective reweighting improves complete-H initialization but fails the two-additional-Seed endpoint confirmation: four of six n35 U comparisons regress, only one absolute gap improves, and C20 proof time increases at both Seeds. Local B35/X35 Seed1 primal gains coexist with weaker proof endpoints and do not justify further optimization or default adoption of this fixed recipe. The three new same-budget B/P pairs strengthen the default method's endpoint evidence, while all n35 runs remain open. Preserve these mixed and adverse findings and close the C169 optimization line.
